tools.title: The Secret Life of Your Socks
tools.imageAlt: Illustration: a toy laundry corner with matched sock pairs on a clothesline and one lonely amber sock on the floor
tools.description: A playful but rigorous model about orphan socks, mismatch penalties, and sustainable everyday decision-making.
tools.text: A playful but rigorous model of orphan socks, mismatch penalties and sustainable everyday decisions. It shows how ACML turns a surprising question into a model, a story and an interactive experience, with a calculator you can try yourself.

tools.title: Scholar Disruptiveness Analyzer
tools.imageAlt: Illustration: a network of papers with one amber paper under a magnifying glass, linked to newer papers while older ones fade, beside a small bar chart
tools.description: Analyze an OpenAlex researcher profile and inspect paper-level disruptiveness statistics, distributions, and relationships.
tools.text: Analyze a researcher's OpenAlex profile and inspect paper-level disruptiveness statistics, distributions and relationships. Useful for exploring a publication portfolio through a scientometrics lens, with visual summaries and exportable tables.

tools.title: Stats Guider
tools.imageAlt: Illustration: a data table under a glass dome, with a path past signposts leading to the chart that fits the data
tools.description: Upload a CSV, map variables, review a transparent test recommendation, and run browser-side statistical analysis.
tools.text: Upload a CSV, map your variables, review a transparent test recommendation and run the analysis with one of 13 statistical methods. Everything runs in your browser, so the data is never sent to a server. Useful for students and researchers who want a structured path from a raw table to an interpretable result.

tools.title: Authorship Deal Risk Checker
tools.imageAlt: Illustration: five figures each holding a string tied to a stack of manuscript pages, one string fraying, with a risk gauge in front
tools.description: Estimate how fragile a proposed academic authorship arrangement is before submission using transparent browser-only heuristics.
tools.text: Estimate how fragile a proposed academic authorship arrangement is before submission, using transparent heuristics that run only in your browser. You get a risk score and suggested actions, and a calm, structured way to surface likely veto points, under-credit signals and late-stage renegotiation risk.
